basic_details.short_information: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (CDAC) has published the Consultant Recruitment Notification 2026 on its official website. The recruitment drive aims to fill 4 Consultant positions. Candidates with a maximum age limit of 56 years and holding B.E/B.Tech in CSE/ECE/EEE/IT or relevant disciplines with 60% marks, M.E/M.Tech/Post Graduate degree with 60% marks, or Ph.D. in relevant disciplines are eligible to apply. salary_details.details: Monthly remuneration shall be fixed appropriately as per the industry standard and based on the experience and performance in the interview. Attendance will be recorded on a monthly basis and there will be proportionate deduction in remuneration w.r.t. attendance of that particular month. TDS and other taxes shall be deducted as applicable from time to time. In case of any official tour, expenses will be paid as per rules of C-DAC. The selected candidate is eligible for eight days leave during the tenure of one year, which will be calculated on prorate basis.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for CDAC Consultant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CDAC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CDAC Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the CDAC Consultant recruitment is 10-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Consultant position at CDAC.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Consultant role?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is a B.E/B.Tech. or M.E/M.Tech/Post Graduate degree in specific domains with 60% or equivalent CGPA, or a Ph.D. (all but thesis).

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 56 years as of 01.06.2026.

faq.question: Q5. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply by sending their complete application along with their updated resumes and required documents via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for the Consultant position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Consultant position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes pre-qualification/minimum eligibility criteria, an evaluation process, and an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for the Consultant role?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration will be fixed appropriately based on industry standards, experience, and interview performance.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the CDAC office located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for CDAC in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.
